description: This file declares encoding utility functions (such as Base64 encoding/decoding), output functions for encoding, and related function types used within the HDK (Home Device Kit) encoding modules. It serves as an interface for encoding-related operations in the project.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeToBuffer
methods.description: Encodes data into a buffer, handling the main output operation.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string using a provided encoding function.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes data in base64, maintaining state across multiple calls.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeBase64Done
methods.description: Completes a base64 encoding process, flushing any remaining data.

methods.name: HDK_DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes base64 data, maintaining state across calls.

methods.name: HDK_DecodeBase64Done
methods.description: Completes a base64 decoding, handling any remaining input.

ctags.name: HDK_EncodeFn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*HDK_EncodeFn)(void* pEncodeCtx, char* pBuf, unsigned int cbBuf);$/
